powerAlternatives.name: SmartThings · USB-A1 proposal
powerAlternatives.cable: Konnected USB-A to5V DC barrel · 5.5mm outer / 2.1mm inner · center positive · 1m
powerAlternatives.route: PDU front USB-A1 through brush to SmartThings DC input
powerAlternatives.label: USB-A1 SMARTTHINGS
powerAlternatives.note: Cable manufacturer explicitly supports SmartThings Hubv2/v3. FCC applicant photo of original MLF-B250502000CU adapter confirms5V2A and center-positive polarity. Connector research is resolved; no user measurement needed. PDU manual lists3A shared at5V; hub reports2A. This fits the total current budget with other USB sockets empty, but individual-port continuous rating is unpublished. Proposed power-up test only: obtain cable, disconnect original hub adapter, connect USB-A1, check stable boot and operation. If it fails to start or restarts, restore original adapter at PDU6. No successful PDU/hub test is claimed.
actions: Use the Konnected cable linked above: USB-A to5V, 5.5 ×2.1mm, center positive.
Connector and polarity confirmed from manufacturer compatibility and original adapter evidence.
The PDU individual USB-port current rating is unpublished; this pairing needs a physical power-up test.
Obtain the cable; it is not assumed to be owned.
Disconnect the original SmartThings power adapter.
Connect PDU USB-A1 to the hub DC barrel input with that cable.
Leave the other PDU charging sockets empty during the initial test.
Check that the hub boots and stays operating without restarts.
If it fails to boot or restarts, restore its original adapter at PDU6.
Do not connect both power sources at once.
